input.summary:
P1 north-east bedroom (parts/room-15.mjs): red bed with head on the east wall, chest dresser with candle, barrel nightstand with standing lantern, potted poppy. Verified on an unlocked copy: `mcd room` says OK (walk ok, min light 11, FIT ok).
In the real make.sh run all 7 writes are REFUSED: the shell's interior air fill locks every room cell, so this part is not in build.nbt yet.
Other rooms will hit the same lock. The fix belongs in shell-west or runParts, not in this module.
left: The room is not in build.nbt: runParts refuses all 7 writes because shell-west's g.fill(..., "air") over the room interior is an owned write. Fix upstream: shell should leave room interiors unwritten, or runParts should lock only non-air cells. Re-run ./make.sh after that; expect 0 refused.

Library bug: bed() in tools/src/build.mjs tests air with /(^|_)air$/, which misses "minecraft:air" on a loaded grid, so it returns false and places nothing. room-15.mjs works around it with a local bedAt(); the library fix would be /(^|:|_)air$/.

Door position: the spec says the door is at (26,6..7,15) but the plan grid shows the wall line at x25. The room check's walk is OK from the grid as built, but the real partition is unconfirmed until the shell's walls are in.
Render: the rooms --out image from above shows only the roof, because the roof part is still a stub in this copy; the interior look is not yet checked by eye.

waste.what: Found that bed() silently refuses on a loaded grid (the air regex misses minecraft:air) only after a room check showed the head cell missing; debugged by reading the library source and dumping block states by hand.
waste.cost: about 3 tool calls and one rebuild of the check copy
waste.tool: A library bed() that accepts minecraft:air, or a `mcd bedcheck` that reports refused beds with the reason.

waste.what: Verified the room's layout on an unlocked copy by writing a throwaway loader script (load build.nbt, call build(g), save a check file) because runParts' lock refuses every room write.
waste.tool: A `mcd room --part <module>` or runParts option that runs one part on the saved shell without the lock, so room designers can verify before merge.

waste.what: Worked out the 3x3 floor layout and the light positions by hand from the plan grid, the window and bed-wall rules.
waste.tool: `mcd room --suggest` that proposes bed and furniture cells from the plan grid (bed against a solid wall, lane kept clear, lantern spots).

companions.task: Stop writing air over room interiors (the g.fill(..., "air") at each room box), so the rooms stay unwritten and the runParts lock doesn't refuse furniture. Leave the openings air only where a door or window is cut.

Check the ceiling over the box at y9 once the roof is in: if it is solid, the hanging lantern is free; if not, the standing lantern on the barrel stays as the light. I would ask them to confirm the light map from the real roof.
